title: I Married My Best Friend to Shut My Parents Up
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Machi Morimoto, an office worker in her early thirties, is tired of her parents pressing her to marry a man. Her younger friend Hana Agaya, a lesbian who needs a new apartment and still secretly loves Machi, suggests they move in together with a same-sex partnership certificate as a sham marriage. Through the parents' homophobia and the return of Hana's ex-girlfriend, Machi falls for Hana, and the single volume ends with a real relationship.
life_message: A good marriage is built on real affection and mutual care, even when it begins as an arrangement against family pressure.
